This suggests that Talmapimod may modulate cellular signaling through the Kir6.2-KV1.1 channel, which could influence the activity of downstream kinases like MAPK14. The integration of these targets highlights a possible role for Talmapimod in regulating cellular processes through a complex network of ion channels and signaling pathways.
